description: Hand a research, data analysis or writing task to HumanPen's cloud agents, with local files as its input: they scope it with the user, propose a plan, do the work, have it reviewed and deliver files. COSTS CREDITS once a plan is confirmed (charged by use; there is no price up front): show the user the plan and get their agreement before act_on_project confirm_plan, unless they set autonomy with a max_credits. Needs an API key with "Research projects" ticked.

autonomy.description: Let it run unattended within a credit cap the user set; omit to stop for the user at every step

answer.description: recommended: answer the agents' questions with their recommended answers

confirm_plan.description: auto: confirm a plan when HumanPen's estimate of it fits what is left of max_credits

max_credits.description: The most the whole project may be charged, every round together; a figure the user agreed to

files.description: Absolute paths of input files (data, drafts, papers)

lang.description: The language to write in, e.g. en or zh

request.description: What the user wants done, in their words: the goal, the deliverables, any constraints

title.description: A name for the project; one is made from the request if omitted

name: start_project
title: Start a research project
